profile.headline: Technical Lead | Senior Software Engineer | Senior Systems Engineer | AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate | Systems Design and Analysis Engineer | Production Support Lead | Software/Systems Integration Engineer
profile.summary: With 23 years of software engineering experience, I bring deep expertise across the full software development lifecycle—from initial requirements analysis through integration, validation, and deployment. I’ve led engineering teams of up to 20 people, providing technical direction, mentorship, and delivery oversight. My core technical strengths include design and development work with Java and C++, along with the versatility to work effectively in a wide range of scripting languages and middleware tools. I have strong proficiency with Linux environments, command-line tools, Bash scripting, SQL, and I’ve spent significant time working in lab settings performing and facilitating integration testing and requirements validation. I’m driven by solving complex problems, building reliable systems, and helping teams deliver high-quality software solutions.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description:
Realestate Investor:
Investment Property management including Rent collection, Maintenance Management, property value appraisal, and Property marketing and rental pricing analysis

positions.title: Senior Lead Software/System Engineer
positions.description:
· Production Support technical lead, troubleshooting of customer-facing websites and web tools (Tricare West health care administration software, contract supporting HNFS-Health Net Federal Services).

· Lead team of 20 developers working through Agile Scrum Methodology managed in JIRA

· Implement, Test, Review, and Deploy Java code changes; SOAP Microservices design pattern; Subversion (SVN) Configuration Management, Heavy Linux CLI use

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
On-site with Raytheon - GPS OCX
Common Framework - Sr Software Engineer

Back-end Java development of SOAP and REST web services, Hibernate, JPA

Software integration in multiple target environments 

Perform Integration Checkout and Verification in Lab environment for incremental build installations

System domain debug/troubleshooting in secure lab; 35+ virtual hosts, Linux and Windows

Use chef deployment tools to install APIs and deploy web services to managed servers

positions.title: Real-Time Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop detailed design for software components using Rational Rhapsody software (Use Case, Sequence, and Object-Model diagrams)(P-8A, Chinook, Apache training simulations)

- Develop C++ code (system components and unit tests) on Windows 7 OS using Eclipse IDE and based on detailed design and requirements documents

- Integrate C++ code into Rational Clearcase configuration management system

- Perform system integration and regression testing in System Integration Lab

positions.title: Real-Time Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Development and packaging of Software and Documentation of Middleware software library sets (C, C++, and Java programming Languages)(FCS-Future Combat Systems platform).  

- Automation of over 10,000 pages of API Documentation generation using XML DITA, XSL Scripts, ANT Script, and Perl Scripts.

- Organize and Facilitate final peer review of 10,000 page Programmers Reference Manual per quarterly build cycle

positions.title: Electronics/Software Design and Analysis Engineer
positions.description:
- Development of Software Requirements for integrated avionics electronic systems (F-18 Electronic Attack platform).

- Integration, Regression, and Stress testing of C++ software with real Avionics hardware

- Created and facilitated Power Point presentations of software requirements for government customers
